demo.bio:
I'm a photographer and filmmaker who believes the best pictures happen when nobody is posing. For over ten years I've documented weddings, families and brands with a calm, natural eye.

Every session is a collaboration: we talk, we plan, and then I disappear into the background so the real moments can unfold.

f1.question: How far in advance should I book?
f1.answer: Weddings are usually booked 6 to 12 months ahead. Portraits and events can often be arranged within a few weeks.

f2.question: When will I receive my photos?
f2.answer: A preview within a week, and the full private gallery within 4 to 6 weeks, ready to download in high resolution.

f3.question: Do you travel?
f3.answer: Yes, anywhere in the country and abroad. Travel costs are included in a clear quote before you book.

faq.title: A few things you might wonder.

trial.q: Can I try AuraDesk before paying?
trial.a: Yes. Every plan starts with a free first month, with no credit card required. After that, plans start at 19 DT per month.

migrate.q: Can I migrate my existing clients?
migrate.a: Absolutely. Import contacts, projects, and contracts from a CSV, or let our concierge team handle it.

galleries.a: Every plan includes beautiful, mobile-ready galleries. Storage limits vary by plan.

commission.a: Never. Payments go directly to your connected account, with no AuraDesk commission.

team.q: Can my team use the same workspace?
team.a: Studio plans include five seats, granular permissions, and shared workflow templates.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: AuraDesk helps photographers run their studio: bookings, clients, projects, galleries, invoices and a public website. This policy explains what personal data we process, why, and the choices you have. It applies to photographers who use AuraDesk, to their clients, and to visitors of the sites built with it.

sections.title: Who is responsible
paragraphs: For photographer accounts and this website, AuraDesk is responsible for the data (data controller).

For the data a photographer keeps about their own clients (contact details, bookings, galleries, invoices), the photographer is responsible, and AuraDesk processes it only on their behalf and following their instructions.

sections.title: What we collect
items: Account data: name, email address, phone number, password (stored only in hashed form) and language.
Studio data: studio name, city, website content, packages and prices.
Client work: the contact details, bookings, projects, messages, invoices and payments a photographer records.
Photos and videos uploaded to galleries and websites, with technical details (size, dimensions, capture date, camera).
Security data: sign-in sessions, IP address and browser type.

sections.title: Why we use it
items: To provide the service: accounts, websites, galleries, bookings and invoicing.
To send the messages you expect, by email or SMS: invitations, booking confirmations, gallery and delivery notices.
To keep the service secure and prevent abuse.
To answer your questions and support requests.
paragraphs: We never sell personal data and never use it for advertising.

sections.title: Photos and location
paragraphs: Photos shown on public websites are stored so that anyone can view them. Their GPS position is removed in your browser before upload, and large photos are reduced to web size.
Client galleries are private: only the invited client can open them, or people the photographer chooses to share a link with. Photographers can also remove location data from gallery photos.

sections.title: Where data is stored
paragraphs: Data is kept in a secured database and files in Cloudflare R2 storage. Emails and text messages go through delivery providers that only receive what is needed to send them.
Some providers may be located outside Tunisia. We only use providers that protect the data under contract.

sections.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Account data is kept while the account is open. Photographers choose how long delivered galleries are kept, from their Privacy & data page, and proofs of delivered projects are removed automatically.
When an account is deleted, its data and files are erased, except invoices the law requires the photographer to keep.

sections.title: Your rights
paragraphs: Under Tunisian Organic Law No. 2004-63 on the protection of personal data, and the GDPR where it applies, you can access, correct, export or delete your data and object to its use.

Signed-in users can export their data or delete their account at any time from the Privacy & data page. Clients of a photographer can also contact that photographer directly. You may lodge a complaint with the INPDP (Instance Nationale de Protection des Données Personnelles).

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: We only use the cookies the service needs: your sign-in session, your language and your theme. There are no advertising or third-party tracking cookies.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we change this policy in a way that matters, signed-in users are told by email or in the app before the change applies.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms set the rules for using AuraDesk. By creating an account, you accept them. Please also read our privacy policy, which explains how data is handled.

sections.title: The service
paragraphs: AuraDesk gives photographers tools to manage bookings, clients, projects, galleries, invoices and a public website. Their clients use it to follow their projects, choose photos and download their files.

sections.title: Your account
paragraphs: Give accurate information and keep your password safe. You are responsible for what happens in your account, including the actions of team members you invite. You must be at least 18 to open a photographer account.

sections.title: Free month and plans
paragraphs: Every plan starts with a free first month, with no credit card required. After it, the plan you choose is billed in Tunisian dinars (DT), monthly or yearly, at the price shown on the pricing page.
You can cancel at any time: your plan stays active until the end of the period already paid. Any price change is announced at least 30 days in advance.

sections.title: Your content
paragraphs: You keep all rights to your photos, videos and texts. You only give AuraDesk the permission needed to store, process and display them to provide the service, for example to resize a photo or show it on your website.
You confirm that you hold the rights and consents this requires, including from the people you photograph.

sections.title: Acceptable use
items: No illegal, hateful or violent content, and no sexual content involving minors.
No content you do not have the rights to.
No spam, and no messages to people who have not agreed to receive them.
No attempts to break, overload or get into the service or other accounts.

sections.title: Your clients' data
paragraphs: When you add your clients' information, you are responsible for having a valid reason to use it and for telling them how it is used. AuraDesk processes it only on your behalf, as described in the privacy policy.

sections.title: Availability
paragraphs: We work to keep AuraDesk available and your data safe, but the service is provided as is, without a guarantee that it will never be interrupted. Keep your own copies of important files.

sections.title: Suspension and closing
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time from the Privacy & data page. We may suspend an account that seriously or repeatedly breaks these terms, after a warning whenever possible.

sections.title: Liability
paragraphs: As far as the law allows, AuraDesk is not liable for indirect losses such as lost profit or lost bookings. Our total liability is limited to the amounts you paid in the 12 months before the event.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by Tunisian law. We will first try to settle any dispute amicably; failing that, the courts of Tunis have jurisdiction.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may update these terms. Important changes are announced at least 30 days before they apply.
